I am trying to find a wax that works best for me and this is the forth brand I have tried and it has been the worst.  This wax hurt more than any other wax I have tried. Obviously wax in general hurts because you are pulling your hair out but this wax just felt like it was pulling at skin and not the hair.  The wax also would only get maybe a couple hairs per strip. Wow! Can’t say enough about this wax. First off it’s soooo easy to use and pulls the hair right out leaving you with a smooth finish for weeks! The long elasticity of the special leg wax makes it so nice for bigger areas! It’s a yes for me!

This has been the best purchase I have made. My legs are as smooth as ever. Its the perfect thickness. The wax is so elastic o can make huge strips which is a game changer. Will definitely be repurchasing.

reviews.t: Works great, low smell. Easy to use.
reviews.x: I’ve been using these for about a year now and love them. They melt quickly and don’t have a strong smell. Definitely gets rid of course hair and fine hair, I use it on my legs, bikini line and husbands back. Takes everything off in one swoop and is easy to use once you get the hang of it. I wish it included more popsicle sticks but I just buy extra elsewhere.

reviews.t: Okay, but maybe not for my type?
reviews.x: It smells good, but I think the extra elasticity didn't help for the type of leg hair I have. It worked better for the fine hairs, but less so for the thicker/darker ones. Unfortunately those are the ones I really wanted it to work on!  I think I'll stick to the blue beads for coarse hair.

reviews.t: Not as good as Bikini Babe
reviews.x: I was so excited to try this out. It was going to save me so much time. That's not what happened at all. This stuff is so gummy and it took forever for it to set enough that I could pull it off. In my experience the stretch made it more painful than using the regular blue wax for coarse hair. I did one leg with the purple wax and then switched back to the blue for the other leg. The blue took me half the time the purple did and saved on so much pain! Ultimately it did it's job, but I'm sticking
Great for beginners!!! Pull FAST don’t go slow or else it will feel like hell! Wait until the wax is a honey like consistency and do even strips! This stuff is gold once you get the hang of it<3

reviews.t: Good all around brand and product.
reviews.x: I have used the Kolua brand wax on many occasions and it is always a dependable product. You get a solid full bag with good size beads for a good price. This is a refill pkg so it comes with a few sticks. They have other sets you can get that comes with more accessories if you need them and all are well made. This size bag will last me 4-6 waxing sessions for legs and underarms.

Ever since the pandemic started I learn to wax at home. These are great whites Pebbles for what they're made for! Highly recommended. If you're new to waxing please do just a little bit of research to make sure you know what kind of wax you're getting for the type of hair you're removing. It's very helpful!

I’ve tried this one and the pink one and the pink one is garbage compared to the purple one. I only have to apply the wax once and it basically gets everything, the pink wax only gets some and I have to re do it multiple times and then tweeze. The purple one is worth it for sure.
Love it! I have really course hair and it gets it all while leaving my skin soft

I wouldn't recommend this product, it doesn't attach very good to the hair in comparison with other brands I have used. I had to applied multiple times which would irritated my skin and even then it does not work. I have a normal skin type, with other brands i will do 2 applications the most. I also tried two different versions of it, the one for face (thin hair) and the one for legs thinking maybe is my type of hair but I did not got good results. I won't buy this again.

reviews.t: I received an open used bag of wax beads
reviews.x: I was afraid to use the wax because I received it already ripped open and it was obvious that it was a used product that was returned. I was very disappointed because I spent 20 dollars and it didn't get replaced and I didn't receive a refund.

This is easily the most effective wax I’ve used! I didn’t need to do multiple passes on the same area, so waxing was a faster and more efficient experience (and I’m sure my skin appreciated that as well). I will repurchase this when I run out.
This wax is elastic and covers large areas well. I have dark course hair, and this worked great on my legs. My skin is generally more on the sensitive side, but I had no irritation from this wax.
I love Kolua Wax! I have tried many other brands of hard wax and nothing beats this brand. This wax feels high quality, I have sensitive skin and does not irritate my skin like most brands do.

Really great wax for legs. It spreads easily over large areas. I was using the pink one that’s supposed to be for every area but it doesn’t spread nearly as much as this one so it was taking me forever to wax one leg. This one also doesn’t hurt as bad & is definitely more stretchy (which is great for waxing your knees). Only downside is it seems to take a little longer to dry but it’s still great!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wax for being easy to apply and remove, with many calling it great for beginners and at-home use.
The wax's elasticity and ability to make large strips is widely praised as effective for bigger areas like legs.
Several reviewers say it outperforms other brands or waxes they've tried, including the free wax that came with their heater.
A few reviewers report the extra elasticity made it gummy, slower to set, or more painful, and less effective on coarse/dark hair.
Some reviewers note a pleasant or low smell.
